description: psy.agu.com.ar cloud save (images/psy-sync): accounts, anonymous browsers, disk per account, API traffic. See docs/monitoring.md.
title: psy-sampler — Cloud save

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts in the database.

panels.title: Accounts vs cap
panels.description: New sign-ups get 503 at 100% (sync.maxUsers). Alerts: PsySyncUsersNearCap (80%), PsySyncSignupsClosed.

panels.title: New · 24h
panels.description: Accounts created in the last 24h.

panels.title: Active · 24h
panels.description: Accounts that used the API in the last 24h (last-seen is stored with hourly resolution).

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Total accounts over time; a drop is an account deletion (Borrar mis datos).

panels.title: 🕶️ Anonymous visitors (never signed in on that browser)
Anonymous browsers
panels.description: Browsers that checked their session and never signed in there. Each browser keeps a random id in localStorage; rows unseen for 90 days are pruned.

panels.title: New · 24h
panels.description: Browsers first seen in the last 24h.

panels.title: Browsers signed in
panels.description: Share of known browsers that signed in at least once (linked to an account).

panels.title: Visitor table vs cap
panels.description: New browsers stop being recorded at 100%. Alert: PsySyncVisitorsCapReached.

panels.title: Anonymous browsers
panels.description: A sudden climb is most likely a script making up ids (alert: PsySyncAnonymousBurst).

panels.title: 🌍 Countries (Traefik access log → VictoriaLogs; follows the time picker, logs keep 7d)
Visitors by country
panels.description: Distinct client IPs per country hitting psy.agu.com.ar. IP geolocation by DB-IP (db-ip.com), CC BY 4.0.

targets.expr: log.RequestHost:="psy.agu.com.ar" log.client_country:* | stats by (log.client_country) count_uniq("log.request_Cf-Connecting-Ip") visitors | rename log.client_country as country

panels.title: Top countries
panels.description: Distinct client IPs per country. IP geolocation by DB-IP (db-ip.com), CC BY 4.0.

targets.expr: log.RequestHost:="psy.agu.com.ar" log.client_country_name:* | stats by (log.client_country_name) count_uniq("log.request_Cf-Connecting-Ip") visitors | rename log.client_country_name as country | sort by (visitors desc) | limit 15

panels.title: Unique IPs
panels.description: Distinct client IPs (Cloudflare's Cf-Connecting-IP) behind any request to psy.agu.com.ar.

panels.title: Page loads
panels.description: Requests for the page itself (path /).

panels.title: Visitors by country over time
panels.description: Distinct client IPs per country in each interval.

targets.expr: log.RequestHost:="psy.agu.com.ar" log.client_country:* | stats by (log.client_country) count_uniq("log.request_Cf-Connecting-Ip") visitors | rename log.client_country as country

panels.title: Workspaces (all accounts)
panels.description: Sum of the stored workspace JSON.

panels.title: SQLite files
panels.description: psy-sync.db + its WAL on the PVC (includes indexes, free pages and the visitor table).

panels.title: Database vs PVC request
panels.description: local-path does not enforce the PVC size: past 100% it keeps eating the SD card. Alert: PsySyncDataVolumeHigh (80%).

panels.title: SD card free
panels.description: Filesystem under the data volume (the Pi's SD card with local-path).

panels.title: Largest workspace
panels.description: The API refuses saves over 256 KB (413). Alert: PsySyncWorkspaceNearLimit (90%).

panels.title: Disk per account (largest first)
panels.description: Workspace size per account against the per-workspace limit. Only the largest sync.metrics.topUsers accounts are exported.

panels.title: Workspaces by size (cumulative)
panels.description: How many workspaces are at or under each size.

panels.title: Responses by status
panels.description: 401 on /api/state is a signed-out page; 409 is a save from a stale copy (another device saved first); 413 is a workspace over the limit; 503 is the account cap.
